title: Pre-Analysis — Overhead Stowage Standard Offered to the CIRRANE-11 Cabin
abstract: Cancelled pre-analysis of a proposal to offer the deeper overhead stowage standard on the shorter aircraft, stopped when the ceiling attachment substantiation turned out not to transfer between the two types.

sections.objective: Assess whether the deeper overhead stowage standard can be offered on the shorter aircraft, where the cabin cross-section is identical but the ceiling attachment structure differs.
sections.findings_summary: The work order was cancelled six weeks in. Two items were confirmed before it stopped. The cabin cross-section is indeed identical and the bin shell itself would fit unchanged, which is what made the proposal look easy. The ceiling attachment structure is not identical: the shorter aircraft carries a different frame pitch in the centre cabin and the tie-rod positions of the deeper bin do not land on structure at three bays. Substantiating a new attachment at those bays is a structural change rather than a cabin change and was outside the scope the proposal had been raised under. The second finding was that the bulletin, the maintenance task and the illustrated part list are all written for one aircraft type and would each need a second effectivity branch, which the proposal had not costed.
sections.next_steps: Close the work order and raise a structural change request if the commercial case is still wanted. Record the frame pitch difference so that the proposal is not made again in the same form. Return the estimate to the cabin office with the structural scope identified.

similarity_seeds: a cabin fit that transfers between two aircraft with the same cross-section

tasks.title: Compare the ceiling attachment structure between the two types
Cost the second effectivity branch in the published content
Substantiate a new attachment at the three affected bays

expected_findings.rationale: The bulletin is written for one aircraft type throughout and would need a second effectivity branch in the accomplishment instructions, the kit definition and the placard list. None of that had been costed.
expected_findings.resolution: Recorded; no action taken because the proposal was stopped.

expected_findings.rationale: The removal task gives one tie-rod release sequence, which depends on the tie-rod positions. A second type with a different frame pitch would need a second sequence and the caution about releasing the aft rod first may not hold.
expected_findings.resolution: Recorded for any future attempt; no action taken.

expected_findings.rationale: The figure shows one bay and states that the other side is a mirror image, which is true within one type and would not be true across two.

expected_non_findings.reason: Returned on every entity search because it shares the latch hardware and the placard content. The latch-only bulletin applies to the delivered shell and is unaffected by whether the deeper shell is offered on another type.

type_data.conclusion: Work order cancelled. The ceiling attachment structure does not transfer between the two types and the proposal was raised under the wrong scope.
